title: Sagrada Familia tour very good!
text: They organized an excursion to the Sagrada Familia for me and I had a great time!
author: mateomed96

title: The experience was great,...
text: The experience was great, we had a great tour guide, and the tour wasn't too long. It was nice going during sunset.
author: Paul_Y

title: Beautiful church
text: It is so beautiful. Lots of walking. Give yourself lots of extra time so much to see. Tour is about showing you highlights but there is so much more to see
author: Joseph_B

title: Beautiful tour
text: Juan was knowledgeable and paced our visit very well.  Details on the facades, their religious significance, entertwined with history was wonderful!  I will do this tour again!
author: Lisa_H

title: Impressive tour of Sagrada Familia
text: We took the Sagrada Familia English Tour with Clara as a guide. Clara gave us a lot of interesting information in an almost 2 hours tour, and could answer all our questions very professionally. Definitely worth the money and 1000 better than any audio guide.
author: inao962

title: Breathtaking design!
text: The Cathedral was an amazing sight to see!  Everyone visiting Barcelona must see it.   The tour cut down on wait time to get inside and the tour guide was very knowledgeable.
author: Diana_W
